text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through her stellar performances in races, 
expectations for Cheval Grand continue to 
rise. Swept up by the fiery enthusiasm of 
her fans, her spirits soar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having found the desire to continually 
meet expectations, she decided to take on 
a training regimen that pushes her to her 
absolute limits while still taking proper 
care of her body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, her childhood friend Shine 
Praise headed to the Chairwoman's office 
with Student Council President Symboli 
Rudolf, engaged in some serious 
discussion...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the Takarazuka Kinen 
arrived. Watching her classmate respond to 
the cheers of the fans, Cheval Grand 
strengthened her resolve to do her 
absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To never disappoint the people— who 
acknowledged and cheered for me.
